name: WriteLeafOctree
definition: A compute shader that traverses a Sparse Voxel Octree to locate the leaf node for each input voxel, then maps the voxel's attributes into a 3D brick pool texture.
summary: WriteLeafOctree is a compute shader that traverses a Sparse Voxel Octree to map voxel attributes into a 3D brick pool texture, bridging sparse tree and dense rendering buffers.
